scope: Public-source requirements and problem signals mapped to Worldshepherd internal solution components. This is not a Boeing-approved requirements baseline.

requirements.need: Govern APQP/PPAP across launches, work transfers, and process changes.
requirements.solution: Versioned APQP project graph with milestone, owner, evidence, dependency, schedule, exception, and approval state.

requirements.need: Preserve Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and FAI consistency.
requirements.solution: Cross-document revision and evidence dependency checks with stale-state invalidation.
acceptance: process change invalidates stale downstream artifacts

requirements.need: Support proactive and risk-based supplier surveillance.
requirements.solution: Risk-ranked surveillance workspace using bounded supplier/process evidence, finding history, open actions, and source freshness.
acceptance: no risk score silently becomes product acceptance

requirements.need: Manage nonconformance, root-cause, corrective action, and recurrence evidence.
requirements.public_basis: Boeing supplier-quality roles and published quality resources
requirements.solution: NCR -> containment -> root cause -> corrective action -> verification -> recurrence monitoring lineage.
acceptance: open NCRs cannot close without required evidence

requirements.need: Protect digital product definition and configuration lineage.
requirements.public_basis: Boeing Supplier Quality digital product definition requirements
requirements.solution: Configuration baseline and revision lineage for drawing/model/work instruction/process/inspection evidence.
acceptance: production/inspection evidence tied to exact revision

requirements.need: Operate within AS9100-based quality-management expectations without claiming certification.
requirements.solution: Control/evidence mapping to applicable quality clauses with explicit assessed/not-assessed state.
acceptance: no certification claim from mapping alone

requirements.need: Measure whether a quality intervention improves outcomes rather than merely producing documentation.
requirements.public_basis: Worldshepherd evidence doctrine plus Boeing quality/supplier-performance emphasis
requirements.solution: Partner pilot with predeclared baseline, intervention, metrics, effect calculation, uncertainty, and independent review.

requirements.need: Keep supplier engagement and contracting through authorized Boeing channels.
requirements.public_basis: Become a Boeing Supplier / ESLC process
requirements.solution: Partner-safe capability package and contact gate tied to official supplier registration/procurement route.
acceptance: no contract/adoption claim before authorized procurement action

claims_boundary: This map is an internal hypothesis-to-validation requirements map based on public sources. Boeing or Spirit must confirm actual requirements, data definitions, acceptance criteria, compliance obligations, and pilot scope before any production use.
